items.name: CRT Monitor Filter
items.description: Adds retro CRT monitor effects: scanlines, screen curvature, noise, vignette, and phosphor glow — fully tunable.
items.descriptionEn: Adds retro CRT monitor effects: scanlines, screen curvature, noise, vignette, and phosphor glow — fully tunable.

items.name: Text Animation
items.description: Add fade-in/out loop and floating animations to dialogue text — switchable in real time during gameplay.
items.descriptionEn: Add fade-in/out loop and floating animations to dialogue text — switchable in real time during gameplay.

items.name: Custom Cursor
items.description: Replace the default mouse cursor with a custom PNG — just drop the image into img/system/ and you're set.
items.descriptionEn: Replace the default mouse cursor with a custom PNG — just drop the image into img/system/ and you're set.

items.name: Godot Tween Curves
items.description: A 48-curve reference for Godot Tweens (12 Transition × 4 Ease), with usage suggestions — open in browser, no install needed.
items.descriptionEn: A 48-curve reference for Godot Tweens (12 Transition × 4 Ease), with usage suggestions — open in browser, no install needed.

products.title: Our Games
products.subtitle: Hand-crafted immersive worlds awaiting exploration
products.intro: Each title is a small wager with narrative — we braid traditional Chinese folklore with the language of contemporary games, so every story grows its own silhouette in each player's hands.

games.title: The Phantom Of The Museum
games.description: The Phantom Of The Museum is an indie game that combines elements of puzzle solving and exploration.

games.title: The Tale of Spring City
games.description: Ziqing Xu, a young girl from Spring City. Her father mysteriously disappeared soon after. During a strange turn of events, she suddenly gains the ability to see into the supernatural realm—the so-called "Yin Yan." Will she be able to uncover the truth?

games.title: JiaMa Poker
games.description: JiaMa Poker is a strategy card game that combines elements of puzzle solving and exploration.

team.title: Our Team
team.intro: Tunan Studio delves deeply into traditional Chinese folk customs and the cultures of ethnic minorities in Yunnan, using the ninth art form - games - as a medium to convey the beauty of culture to the world.
team.vision: Meanwhile, we are also expanding into the fields of novels and films and television series, striving to achieve cross-media and multi-dimensional breakthroughs and explore the infinite possibilities of narrative.
